title: JointBase
description: Fields common to every joint, regardless of type.

type.description: Recommended values: revolute, prismatic, helical, spherical, universal, planar, fixed. Additional application-defined joint types are permitted; a joint of an unrecognized type is validated against this base shape only, with any type-specific data carried in `metadata`.

parent.description: Id of the body on the parent side of this joint.

child.description: Id of the body on the child side of this joint.

coordinates.description: This joint's generalized coordinates (its degrees of freedom's variables).

metadata.description: Opaque, application-defined data carried alongside this joint.
